title: Draft Restore
summary: Autosaves a form locally and offers the draft back on reopen, keeping any value the server changed since, so work isn't lost or stale data restored.
description: Autosaves to localStorage and, on reopen, offers the draft with a field-by-field preview that keeps any value the server changed since, unless you tick it. Drafts expire after 7 days by default.
catches: Form work lost to a refresh, crash or closed tab
Stale draft values that would overwrite newer server values, kept server-side unless chosen
limits: Drafts live in this browser's localStorage: not on other devices, and cleared with site data
Don't store sensitive fields; use `exclude` for passwords, card numbers and similar
Anyone with access to the device can read localStorage
a11y: Preview toggle uses aria-expanded and aria-controls
